description: Java class defining NotificationRequest, a data model for notification requests in the Thingsboard platform, including fields, constructors, and helper methods.

classes.name: NotificationRequest
classes.description: Data model class for notification requests, including fields for tenant, targets, template, info, status, and related identifiers, with constructors and helper methods.

methods.name: NotificationRequest
methods.description: Copy constructor for creating a new NotificationRequest instance from an existing one.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the notification request, specifically the targets.

methods.name: getSenderId
methods.description: Returns the sender's UserId if the originatorEntityId is a UserId, otherwise null.

methods.name: isSent
methods.description: Checks if the notification request status is SENT.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description: Checks if the notification request status is SCHEDULED.
